description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'CounterAggregatorGroup' which manages a collection of 'CounterAggregator' instances keyed by 'TagList'. It provides methods to find or create aggregators, add measurements with various tag combinations, and collect non-zero measurements.

classes.name: CounterAggregatorGroup
classes.description: Manages a group of CounterAggregator instances, allowing addition of measurements and collection of results based on tags.

methods.name: FindOrCreate
methods.description: Finds an existing CounterAggregator for the given TagList or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a measurement with specified tags to the appropriate CounterAggregator.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects all non-zero measurements from the aggregators.
